title: Checkout failures after database deployment
root_cause: orders-db-4.2 changed the listener port to 5433 while checkout-service still used 5432.
recommended_action: Align the database listener and client configuration after human approval; validate connectivity before restoring traffic.

title: Authentication failures after signing-key rotation
root_cause: auth-service instances did not refresh the new signing key set and continued referencing key-2025.
recommended_action: Refresh the key set on all auth-service instances and verify token validation with a canary request.

title: Recommendation latency after catalog deployment
root_cause: catalog-service-7.1 introduced one upstream request per item instead of a batched request, causing query fan-out.
recommended_action: Restore batched querying or add bounded batching after human review, then compare p95 latency.

title: Profile update failures after API v3
root_cause: profile-api-v3 introduced a breaking phoneNumber schema change without backward-compatible producer handling.
recommended_action: Restore compatibility or coordinate producer and consumer schema migration after human approval.
